crop.notes: Clipping holds a billiards item, 'The Manly Art' (the Allen item), a baseball notice and a furniture ad. Only 'The Manly Art' is about Allen.

ocr.notes: Readable; 'pnutup his Qykes' is 'put up his dukes'.

title.suggested: Allen to Spar Tom Kelly at Kelly's Benefit

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen had agreed to spar Tom Kelly at the Theater Comique that evening at Kelly's benefit, the two having not boxed each other for some years.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Friday Morning, May 5, 1876, page 6 (same page as 552). Current title and summary describe the Bauer stakes story (552), not this clipping.

facts.fact: Allen sparred Tom Kelly at the Theater Comique, St. Louis, at a benefit for Kelly
